name: Jade & Ivory: 3D Reversi
subtitle: Flip discs, learn why it works
shortDescription: Eight levels, a perfect endgame solver, 96 solved puzzles, an openings trainer and review. Classic, Small and Anti Reversi.
longDescription:
Reversi was invented in England in the 1880s and reborn in the twentieth century as a game whose rules fit on a beer mat and whose strategy fills books. Jade and Ivory is the flipping-discs game made with care: real-time 3D, an opponent you can trust, and several ways to learn why moves work.

Choose Classic 8x8, the quick Small 6x6 board, or Anti-Reversi where fewest discs wins. Play eight computer levels from Pebble to Grandmaster, plus Adaptive, which follows your rating; the top level searches deep and then solves the last sixteen squares perfectly. Share a device and turn the board toward the other player, or open Auto Play, where the computer plays both sides with a plain line for each move. Pause, change speed, ask Think or take over at any moment. Hints mark the strongest move, a coach grades each move, and an evaluation bar shows who is ahead.

Learn with fourteen interactive lessons on corners, mobility, quiet moves, edges, stable discs, parity, forcing a pass and counting the ending. A campaign of 96 puzzles in eight chapters was solved exactly by a perfect solver, so the best move is a fact, not an opinion. An openings trainer teaches named lines, lets you practise against the book and test yourself from memory. Daily challenges share a puzzle and an opening each day with a streak, and game review lets you step through any save.

Boards come in felt, lacquer, maple and slate. Free with ads; go ad-free with an optional monthly pass or by earning time from videos.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
